record.question: What is the core message of the United Nations Population Fund's 'State of World Population Report 2025', titled "The Real Fertility Crisis: The Pursuit of Reproductive Agency in a Changing World"?
options: Fertility rates are stabilizing globally, reducing the need for population-related policies.
The world is heading toward overpopulation due to high fertility rates.
The real crisis lies in individuals' inability to achieve their reproductive goals due to lack of agency.
The main challenge is population collapse due to declining birth rates.
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation:
UNFPA’s 10 June 2025 release says millions cannot have the number of children they want because economic and social barriers constrain their choices. It calls this the central finding of the 2025 State of World Population report and frames the issue as reproductive agency. The question is about that report’s message, not a standalone fertility-rate forecast.

Reference: https://www.unfpa.org/press/unfpa-report-links-falling-birth-rates-cost-living-sexist-norms-fear-future

Reference: https://cpcb.nic.in/noise_data/Noise_Report_2016.pdf
